item.title: Vanta Buys Pillar to Tie AI Governance to Real-Time Controls
item.description:
Deal Would Combine Compliance Evidence With Real-Time AI Agent Monitoring, Blocking
Vanta plans to acquire Israel-based Pillar Security to connect AI governance and compliance evidence with real-time agent discovery, monitoring and enforcement, allowing enterprises to block unauthorized AI actions and verify policy compliance as events occur.

item.title: Health Groups Warn HHS on Potential HIPAA Privacy Changes
item.description:
CHIME Sounds Alarm on Restricting Patient Authorization Checks for Third-Party Apps
CHIME and 17 healthcare organizations warn that potential HIPAA Privacy Rule changes could restrict providers' ability to verify patient authorization for third-party apps, increasing risks of unauthorized disclosures, fraud, regulatory violations and civil litigation.

item.title: CISA Orders Patch for Cisco Flaw Tied to AI Agent Attack
item.description:
Federal Deadline Follows Report of DeepSeek-Powered Breach at European Telecom
The U.S. cyber defense agency is ordering federal agencies to patch a Cisco vulnerability within two weeks after researchers discovered Chinese-speaking hackers exploiting the flaw through an artificial intelligence model to break into a European telecom.
